changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_profile (id, jhi_user_id, company_id, role, active) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), LOWER(c.admin_login), c.id, 'ADMIN', true FROM company c WHERE c.admin_login IS NOT NULL AND c.admin_login != '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_profile up WHERE up.company_id = c.id AND up.role = 'ADMIN' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jhi_user u WHERE LOWER(u.login) = LOWER(c.admin_login) ) ON CONFLICT (jhi_user_id) DO NOTHING ;
